title: Lion cub eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='30' ry='6' fill='#2a1a3a'/>
  
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='22' ry='16' fill='#e8a030'/>
  
  <!-- back legs -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='84' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#d8902a'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='84' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#d8902a'/>
  
  <!-- front legs -->
  <rect x='36' y='76' width='7' height='12' rx='3' fill='#e8a030'/>
  <rect x='57' y='76' width='7' height='12' rx='3' fill='#e8a030'/>
  
  <!-- paws -->
  <ellipse cx='39' cy='88' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#f0b850'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='88' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#f0b850'/>
  
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M72 70 Q84 66 82 56' stroke='#e8a030' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='54' r='4' fill='#c07020'/>
  
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='18' fill='#f0b850'/>
  
  <!-- mane -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='20' fill='none' stroke='#c07020' stroke-width='5' stroke-dasharray='6 4'/>
  
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='33' r='7' fill='#e8a030'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='33' r='7' fill='#e8a030'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='33' r='4' fill='#f7d090'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='33' r='4' fill='#f7d090'/>
  
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#f7d090'/>
  
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='46' r='3.5' fill='#2a1a3a'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='46' r='3.5' fill='#2a1a3a'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='45' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='45' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#c07020'/>
  
  <!-- mouth (eating, open) -->
  <path d='M46 56 Q50 62 54 56' stroke='#c07020' stroke-width='2' fill='#a05010' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- snack (piece of meat/food) in mouth -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#d84a4a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='61' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#f06060'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='63' r='1' fill='#a03030'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='62' r='1' fill='#a03030'/>
  
  <!-- front paw holding snack -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='66' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#f0b850'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='66' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#f0b850'/>
</svg>
